rationale: The compiled artifact faithfully realizes the reviewed design: the selector traces exactly the assigned route (message_reactions→users→channel_members→channels→teams), filtering on message_id (realizing REACTION's FK to the named Tokyo message without an extraneous MESSAGE join, consistent with the design note that message identity rides on the reaction row itself), real_name contains 'Robert' (USER), channel_name='core-infra' (CONVERSATION), and team_name='Test Workspace' (WORKSPACE). This produces exactly one computed match (U_ROBERT/muscle on 1706027877.000000), matching the design's single-resolution intent and answer_attributes (message_reactions.reaction_type = 'muscle'). The four inserted message_reactions rows correspond precisely to the planned target and three negatives (wrong-Robert-same-message, right-channel-wrong-person, right-person-wrong-message), each still grounded in pre-existing seed facts (Robert Walsh's channel_members rows confirm his absence from C_INFRA; Robert Chen's confirm his presence; both Tokyo and cloud-bill messages already existed in the seed at the cited timestamps/channels). Deterministic created_at values were supplied per the runtime qualification. The extra pre-existing seed reaction (eyes on an unrelated OOM message) appears only as a harmless additional negative in computed_focal_negatives, not affecting the single match. No mechanical errors were reported, and none are evident on review: bindings, selectors, and candidate population all agree with the design's stated match/negative structure.
